aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it misstates the primary change and overgroups unrelated or misparsed outcomes.
issues: Primary factor should be new dry machine vs normal dry, not mixed old/new method dates and numeric conditions.
Multiple sheets, products, dates, temperatures, times, and processes are collapsed without preserving subgroup context.
Several outcomes are misparsed from headers, notes, pictures, or defect rows as measurements.
Judgements of improvement are unsupported across inconsistent baselines and sample sizes.
Change domains include supplier/material/spec without clear cited evidence as primary factors.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changedFactor as new dry machine/process condition compared with normal dry.
Keep sheet/date/product/process/temperature/time as subgroup keys for each result block.
Separate dry defect rate, tension, Gauss, function, and visual/photo notes into valid outcome domains.
Remove non-data picture/header rows and malformed measurement statistics.
Recalculate judgements only within matched baseline/test rows and cite each source row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient because grouping and interpretation are incorrect.
